title: Design System: Coinflow Merchant Dashboard UI

body.purpose: Controls, data, labels, and application copy.

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input{box-sizing:border-box;height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--input,oklch(.922 0 0));border-radius:8px;background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--input,oklch(.922 0 0)) 20%,transparent);color:var(--foreground,oklch(.145 0 0));font:400 12px/18px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(.556 0 0))}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring,oklch(.708 0 0)) 30%,transparent);outline-offset:0}

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet rail navigation with a clear current state.

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Bordered container for a compact operational summary.

components.name: Data Table Shell
components.description: A bounded, scrollable record list with fine structural separation.
components.css: .ds-table{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border,oklch(.922 0 0));border-radius:14px;background:var(--card,oklch(1 0 0));box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);font:14px/20px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif}.ds-table-head,.ds-table-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px}.ds-table-head{color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(.556 0 0));font-size:12px;font-weight:500}.ds-table-row{border-top:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--border,oklch(.922 0 0)) 70%,transparent);color:var(--foreground,oklch(.145 0 0))}.ds-table-row:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--muted,oklch(.97 0 0)) 65%,transparent)}

narrative.overview: This is a calm, exacting interface for a payment-operations workspace. It keeps the operational signal in the foreground: crisp text, white working surfaces, a narrow tonal range, and thin dividers do the organizing. Density is purposeful rather than austere—information stays close enough to scan quickly without making investigation feel compressed.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, desktop-first operational rhythm with responsive escape hatches.
Tonal hierarchy through surfaces and borders before shadows.
Semantic color is status-bearing; chart blues are data-bearing.
Rounded rectangles are soft enough to be approachable, never decorative.

rules.name: Signal-Only Color
rules.body: Color earns its place by indicating a status, data series, focus, or selection; it is not used as ambient decoration.

rules.name: Workmanlike Type
rules.body: Use weight and tone to establish hierarchy before increasing size; large type belongs to page or summary moments, not routine controls.

rules.name: Structural Lift
rules.body: Borders establish ordinary containment. Shadows are reserved for bounded surfaces that need separation from their immediate surroundings.

dos: Do make data, status, and task completion the visual focal points.
Do use thin borders and tonal contrast before adding elevation.
Do reserve semantic hues for status, validation, and data relationships.
Do preserve a compact responsive path from desktop rail to mobile navigation drawer.
donts: Don't use shadows as everyday ornament or stack multiple lifted containers.
Don't apply saturated color to broad page surfaces without a meaningful state or data role.
Don't expand routine controls into oversized, consumer-app forms.
Don't make navigation or decorative treatment compete with record data.
